# Aykiz Intelligence

> Aykiz Intelligence is the independent one-person app studio of Miraz Mullick, a growth and brand marketing technologist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The studio builds quiet, offline-first apps for mobile and web: Wasilah, Drafy, Crisp, Verbatim, Misbah, and Hirra. The name Aykiz means "moon girl".

Key facts:

- Founded and run solo by Miraz Mullick. He does the strategy, design, code, and marketing for every product himself.
- Miraz has around nine years in brand and digital marketing across agency and in-house leadership (dentsu, US-Bangla Airlines, Hajee Air) and a computer science background.
- Every Aykiz product is free to use. One app, Hirra, keeps its health core free and adds an optional Hirra Plus subscription for AI features.
- The studio is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Contact: hello@aykizintelligence.com.

## Apps

- [Wasilah](https://wasilah.site/): a free Islamic companion app for Muslims in Bangladesh and Bengali-speaking Muslims worldwide. Prayer times, Adhan, Qibla, Quran, Hadith, duas, and a Zakat calculator in BDT. The latest version adds Wasilah Deen Intelligence: ask about salah, fasting, duas, the Quran, or daily practice and get answers with references, with personal-ruling questions pointed to a qualified scholar; three questions a day, free for everyone. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- [Drafy](https://aykizintelligence.com/drafy/): a free static QR code generator with no paywall and no tracking. Eight QR types. Live on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/drafy-qr-code-generator/id6777504506) since June 2026 and also works as a web app. A Google Play release is in closed testing.
- [Crisp](https://aykizintelligence.com/crisp/): a free in-browser PDF toolkit. Merge, split, sign, crop, compress, stamp, and convert photos to PDF. Files are processed on-device and never uploaded.
- [Verbatim](https://aykizintelligence.com/verbatim/): free private speech-to-text transcription that runs entirely in the browser with on-device Whisper. No uploads, no accounts.
- [Misbah](https://aykizintelligence.com/misbah/): "Light in the Dark", a calm one-touch 2D game where oil is sight. No ads, no tracking, fully offline. Live on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mumullickm.misbah) since June 2026 and on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781614427) since July 2026, and playable on the web. Web prototype at https://islamic-games-rho.vercel.app.
- [Hirra](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/): an AI-first cat health app for the Gulf and wider MENA, live on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hirra-cat-health-tracker/id6782975522). A private health record with low-friction daily logging and a rules-based early-warning engine that flags weight loss and thirst drift early, routing owners to a vet without ever diagnosing. The core is free; an optional Hirra Plus subscription adds AI vet triage, a weekly health digest, and a vet-ready PDF. Arabic-first and English. By Aykiz Intelligence.

## Guides

- [Hirra cat care guide](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/): free, plain-language answers to the questions cat owners search most, from the makers of the Hirra cat health app. Covers food safety (is chocolate, onion and garlic, grapes and raisins, milk, tuna, or xylitol safe for cats, and which human foods are safe), household safety (are lilies poisonous to cats, are essential oils and diffusers safe for cats), symptoms (why a cat is drinking so much water, a cat that is not eating, losing weight while still eating, breathing fast, vomiting, or peeing outside the litter box), and care basics (cat vaccination schedule, how often a cat should see the vet, what to feed a kitten). Every guide is non-diagnostic and routes owners to a licensed veterinarian.
- [Are Essential Oils and Diffusers Safe for Cats?](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/are-essential-oils-safe-for-cats/)
- [Are Lilies Poisonous to Cats? Yes, and It Is an Emergency](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/are-lilies-poisonous-to-cats/)
- [Cat Breathing Fast: When It Is an Emergency](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/cat-breathing-fast-what-to-do/)
- [Cat Losing Weight but Still Eating: What It Could Mean](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/cat-losing-weight-but-still-eating/)
- [My Cat Is Not Eating: What It Means and What to Do](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/cat-not-eating-what-to-do/)
- [Why Is My Cat Peeing Outside the Litter Box?](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/cat-peeing-outside-litter-box/)
- [Cat Vaccination Schedule: A Simple Guide for Owners](https://aykizintelligence.com/hirra/guide/cat-vaccination-schedule/)

## Services

- [Cadence](https://aykizintelligence.com/cadence/): a done-for-you short-form content service for brands, run by Aykiz Intelligence. The studio produces and schedules videos and static posts on a client's brand so their social account stays consistent. Cadence Monthly is 12 short videos and 12 static posts a month; the first month runs on a plan the client approves. This is a paid service, separate from the studio's free apps.
